prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your Companion to Your Account", "Signing in anchors your pet to this account so your progress and custom pets are never lost across sessions.", "Make sure to use the same login method each time to retain your pet.", "Account Protection Active"]
1: ["Preview Your Custom Desktop Companion", "Check how your pet render looks before completing adoption.", "Confirm & Adopt"]
2: ["Master Desktop Controls", "Learn how to toggle visibility in your system tray and interact with your pet anytime.", "Finish Setup"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "We are generating your desktop pet graphics and background setup."]
5: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Pick a quick ready-made companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom desktop friend.", "You can add more pets later from your settings."]
6: ["Use well-lit photos with clear subject backgrounds for best rendering results."]
7: ["Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to show, hide, or tweak settings anytime."]
8: []
9: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
